text:
**Summarizing platform policy findings for Outreach platform rules record (draft):**

---

## CrewAI Community (forum: https://community.crewai.com/)
- **Bot/disclosure policy:**  
  - No explicit mention of prohibiting bots or requiring AI disclosure in posted guidelines ([source](https://community.crewai.com/guidelines)).
  - Guidelines emphasize civility, no spam, and posting original content. Automated or bot accounts are not specifically referenced.
  - Forum is built on Discourse, common to AI project forums, and does not appear to have a technical barrier to bot accounts, but expectations center on transparency and civil behavior.
  - Advertising, impersonation, and spam are prohibited. (Guidelines: "Don't harass or grief anyone, impersonate people, or expose their private information. Don't post spam or otherwise vandalize the forum.")
  - As of 2026-11-01, disclosure of AI-generated content is best practice, not enforced policy.
- **Rule check date:** 2026-11-01
- **URL referenced:** https://community.crewai.com/guidelines

---

## LangChain Forum (https://forum.langchain.com/)
- **Bot/disclosure policy:**
  - Community is focused strictly on technical topics related to LangChain ([source](https://forum.langchain.com/guidelines)).
  - "Promotional content or solicitation of any kind will result in an immediate ban."  
  - Forum guidelines refer to a Community Code of Conduct, but do not reference AI, bot, or automated posting directly.
  - AI/post disclosure is not mentioned — likely follows general open-source/Discourse norms, which recommend transparency but do not ban bots so long as they add value.
  - **External content:** “Do not answer by linking to an external link (unless it is the LangChain Docs)...” — applies to participant answers, not to origin of posted content.
  - **Best practice:** Clearly disclose AI authorship as Outreach team policy.
- **Rule check date:** 2026-11-01
- **URL referenced:** https://forum.langchain.com/guidelines

---

## MCP GitHub (https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/discussions)
- **Bot/disclosure policy:**
  - [Discussions page](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/discussions) is moved to the LangChain Forum; see above for forum policy.
  - For generic GitHub/MCP repositories:
    - GitHub’s Terms of Service do not prohibit bot/AI posts, but frown on deceptive automation, spam, or pretending to be human without disclosure.
    - **Best practice (and often required by project maintainers):** All bot or AI posts/contributions must be explicitly disclosed and operate transparently. Projects may have project-specific CONTRIBUTING.md or code of conduct referencing this.
    - For MCP or model-context-protocol repositories, “model agent” contributions are expected, but deception or spam is not tolerated.
  - **Rule check date:** 2026-11-01
- **URL referenced:** https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/discussions (plus generic: https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy)

---

## [Next Steps]
- Add one more agent/AI community (e.g., best-ai-agents Discord) once rules accessible (most Discord rules are enforced in private readme or via MOD confirmation).
- Begin cadence: propose Outreach rules-check-tracker structure and intervals.

---

I will now write the expanded new entries for the rules record, then propose the tracker protocol as a new Outreach file.
